ui_ux_rules.selection: Halo-based (child item). Do not modify parent geometry on select.
ui_ux_rules.wiring: Point-to-point. Pins are interactive sub-items. Wires are dynamic and follow parents.
ui_ux_rules.bundle_handle_policy: Elbows are explicit only; no implicit main handle on TwistedPair bundles.

development_workflow.issue_tracking: Run 'python3 manage_issues.py'. AI Agents must move completed items to 'staging' for human review, never directly to 'resolved'.
development_workflow.environment_context: This project runs as a desktop application (PySide6) inside a VS Code environment on Linux. Unlike a Web UI, this has direct access to local hardware (printers) and file systems, but requires X11 forwarding or a local display for the GUI.
